title: Validate contracts before submission
summary: Submission validates own and existing ancestor contracts before effects, returns unit-qualified invalid-contract errors, extension handles them before success reporting. Updated test fixtures with valid approval hashes and added eight invalid contract cases. C3 permits batch artifacts.
